boundaries.reason: The Statement fixes p in the zero fibre, so its pointed space is nonempty.

boundaries.evidence: Statement and proof steps 1.1, 4.1 and 8.1: constant-zero strata and zero-dimensional affine charts give point or zero-fibre models, with the same transverse-boundary and finite-pair construction.
Statement and proof steps 1.1–8.1: smooth curves and a one-variable function obey exactly the same conormal, rank and cochain arguments.
Statement and proof steps 1.1 and 8.1: constant-function components have empty punctured fibres and the finite pair (U,empty); no nonzero differential is presumed there.
Statement and proof steps 6.1–8.1: marked sphere/function-circle boundaries and their open interiors are treated explicitly.
A1 and proof steps 3.1–4.1: the parameter set is nonempty in every prescribed real open, and the radius avoids a proved finite set.
